title: Invertibility of the adjunct scalar-forgetful comparison
statement: Let k be a field and a:Y → X a morphism of schemes. Let U_X and U_Y be the functors forgetting the k-action on sheaves [new-sc-scalar-abelian-ext-factorization], and let L_k and L_ab be inverse image for k-module sheaves and abelian sheaves respectively [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Define the natural transformation δ: U_X ⋙ L_ab → L_k ⋙ U_Y by taking, at F, the abelian adjunct of U_X of the scalar inverse-image unit at F. Then δ is invertible. For every q:L_k(F) → G, the abelian adjunct of δ_F followed by U_Y(q) equals U_X of the scalar adjunct of q.

source.place: Tags 0096 (lemma-pullback-pushforward-adjoint) and 01F7 (cohomology-equation-functorial); specialization to the explicit Lean constructions

proof.text: Restriction of scalars along integers followed by the equivalence of integer modules with abelian groups has a coextension right adjoint. Restrict this adjunction pointwise to sheaves. The right adjoint commutes with pushforward definitionally. Uniqueness of left adjoints yields an isomorphism between the two composites. Apply the composite hom equivalence to identify its component with δ: the adjunct formula for δ and naturality of the coefficient adjunction unit give precisely the composite unit.
